_what: T17/T20 demo spec: prove the ported action layer moves the player in the player-view rig (face=true runs facing the travel direction, face=false proves steering/movement decoupling) and that the default-OFF control does not move at all. DISCIPLINE (T20): (1) pose in a face=true arm must NOT pin yaw -- the action layer turns the player; (2) shots must be taken INSIDE the motion window (spaced wait_ticks), otherwise the "run" images are all identical post-stop frames; (3) use target=eat needs an edible item selected first (inv select 10 = porkchopx4); (4) act verb=place needs explicit x/y/z.

_judgment.moved: walkrun/noface: dump pos differs from A by >=4 blocks on the target axis; log has AGENT sprint confirm ... attempted=true effective(tick-end)=true and AGENT dir self-check with the matching combo
_judgment.default_off: control: stays at A within 0.01 blocks and its log slice has no RELAY agent line except the explicit !agent stop
_judgment.restore: after postRelay !agent stop the inputs are cleared and setSprinting(false) (log: RELAY agent -> agent=off (inputs restored, sprint cleared))
_judgment.decoupling: noface: yRot stays 180.00 for the whole window while x advances (steering and movement are independent)
_judgment.pose_discipline: In a face=true arm the pose op MUST NOT pin yaw (the action layer turns the player; B4 failed with "settle timeout want yaw=180.00 but yaw=-90.00"). Shots must be taken inside the motion window, otherwise the run images are identical post-stop frames.
_judgment.thresholds: T18-D3 calibration: displacement >=3.0 blocks (5.2-block target, 3.7 observed in the 0.75s window), arrival residual <=0.25 (AgentInput.ARRIVE_R=0.35; measured 0.13). Do NOT set a threshold that can never pass.
_judgment.default_off_criterion: Default-OFF is judged ONLY by two identical state pos readings plus the absence of RELAY agent lines. PNG identity is NOT a criterion: HUD/held-item animation makes control run1/2/3 differ.
_judgment.display_gate: Driver locates images by <shotPrefix>-N, so ticket shot names are <prefix>-1/-2/-3 (inv9), and the driver only accepts PNGs whose mtime is >= arm start (stale same-named PNGs are ignored, not matched as a fake green).
_judgment.place_criterion: act verb=place must report ok AND the world must change: the receipt now carries blockBefore/blockAfter/supportAfter for the clicked support block (T21 root cause: the old implementation clicked the TARGET cell itself, so BlockItem placed one block away or into a solid block -> InteractionResult.FAIL / useOn=FAIL).
_judgment.sampling_window: state samples sit inside the motion window (t~2 and t~26 after pose) because the relay starts the walk before the ticket runs; a sample taken after the walk finishes cannot show displacement.
_judgment.equip_criterion: inv action=equip slot=<head|chest|legs|feet> moves an armor piece from backpack 0-35 into the vanilla armor slot 36-39 (or unequips into an empty slot) and echoes armorBefore/armorAfter plus the slot states. Criterion = state.armor or the slot contents change (not merely ok=true).

_prereq: Window 1280x800; client restarted after compileJava syncShaderPack (T17 added AgentInput + AgentInputMixin + the !agent relay knob). Run tools\check-synth-spec.ps1 first (T17 spec has no synth/paired arms: it only checks the tickets parse).
scoped: window 1280x800 / dev save test / scene wall / start A = wall_front(2000.0,121.5,8.0,yaw180,pitch5) / target B ~5 blocks away / single client / T17 action layer (default OFF)

arms.desc: face=true (run default): !agent goto 2005.2 121.0 8.0 run -> turns to the travel direction + sprint; 3 shots inside the motion window; eat (slot 10) + place(x/y/z)
